turns.en: Are you taking any medication at the moment? Anything over the counter? Any allergies that you know of?
turns.cy: Ydach chi'n cymryd unrhyw foddion ar y funud? Unrhyw beth dros y cownter? Unrhyw alergeddau dach chi'n gwybod amdanyn nhw?
chunks: Are you taking any medication at the moment?
Ydach chi'n cymryd unrhyw foddion ar y funud?
Any allergies that you know of?
Unrhyw alergeddau dach chi'n gwybod amdanyn nhw?
English strands 'of'; Welsh must conjugate it — amdanyn nhw — and gwybod is the factual verb (S5)

turns.en: Just the blood pressure tablet. Amlodipine, I think it's called.
turns.cy: Dim ond y dabled pwysau gwaed. Amlodipine, dw i'n meddwl ydy ei henw hi.
chunks: Dim ond y dabled pwysau gwaed
restrictive 'just' → dim ond; tabled feminine, so the article mutates it
Amlodipine, dw i'n meddwl ydy ei henw hi
Welsh has no be-called passive — it says 'its name is'

turns.en: Amlodipine, that's the one. And you're taking it every day? No trouble with it?
turns.cy: Amlodipine, dyna hi. Ac ydach chi'n ei chymryd hi bob dydd? Dim traffarth efo hi?
chunks: And you're taking it every day?
Ac ydach chi'n ei chymryd hi bob dydd?
English's declarative-as-question needs the Welsh interrogative form — the intonation trick does not carry

turns.en: Every day with my breakfast, regular as clockwork.
turns.cy: Bob dydd efo fy mrecwast i, fel cloc.
chunks: Bob dydd efo fy mrecwast i
English's 'regular as' erases — fel cloc alone is the Welsh idiom

turns.en: Good. Right, I've got everything I need. Let's have a look at you.
turns.cy: Da iawn. Reit — mae gen i bob dim dw i ei angen. Dewch i ni gael golwg arnoch chi.
chunks: Right, I've got everything I need
Reit — mae gen i bob dim dw i ei angen
the mae gen i possessive; angen takes a possessive object ei
Let's have a look at you
Dewch i ni gael golwg arnoch chi
south: mae … gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Da iawn. Reit — mae popeth dw i ei angen gyda fi. Dewch i ni gael golwg arnoch chi.

turns.en: Right you are. On the couch, is it?
turns.cy: O'r gorau. Ar y gwely archwilio, ia?
chunks: English's clinical 'couch' would read as a sofa in Welsh — gwely archwilio names it; the tag is the identificatory ia

turns.en: Any allergies that you know of? Any medication you're taking?
turns.cy: Unrhyw alergeddau dach chi'n gwybod amdanyn nhw? Unrhyw foddion dach chi'n eu cymryd?
chunks: Any allergies that you know of?
Unrhyw alergeddau dach chi'n gwybod amdanyn nhw?
Unrhyw foddion dach chi'n eu cymryd?
⚠ line — the object relative takes a resumptive eu

turns.en: I'm allergic to penicillin. It brings me out in a terrible rash.
turns.cy: Dw i'n alergaidd i benisilin. Mae o'n codi brech ofnadwy arna i.
chunks: ⚠ line — the plainest possible; penisilin in Welsh spelling so it reads aloud correctly
It brings me out in a terrible rash
Mae o'n codi brech ofnadwy arna i
⚠ line — English's 'bring out in' relocates to codi … ar, 'raise a rash on me'

turns.en: Penicillin rash - I'm putting that in big letters on your record now. What happens exactly? Just the rash, or any swelling, any trouble breathing?
turns.cy: Brech penisilin — dw i'n rhoi hynny mewn llythrennau bras ar eich cofnod chi rŵan. Be'n union sy'n digwydd? Dim ond y frech, neu unrhyw chwyddo, unrhyw drafferth anadlu?
chunks: ⚠ line — the Welsh construct chain reverses English's noun-noun order
I'm putting that in big letters on your record now
dw i'n rhoi hynny mewn llythrennau bras ar eich cofnod chi rŵan
⚠ line — 'exactly' fronts with the interrogative in Welsh
Just the rash, or any swelling, any trouble breathing?
Dim ond y frech, neu unrhyw chwyddo, unrhyw drafferth anadlu?
⚠ line — restrictive dim ond; 'any' → unrhyw in the free-choice list (S9)

turns.en: Just the rash, all up my arms. No swelling that I remember.
turns.cy: Dim ond y frech, ar hyd fy mreichiau i gyd. Dim chwyddo dw i'n ei gofio.
chunks: Just the rash, all up my arms
Dim ond y frech, ar hyd fy mreichiau i gyd
⚠ line — English's particle 'up' relocates to ar hyd, 'along'
Dim chwyddo dw i'n ei gofio
⚠ line — the object relative with a resumptive ei

turns.en: That's noted. It means there are one or two antibiotics we'll avoid - and plenty of others we can use safely.
turns.cy: Mae hynna wedi'i nodi. Mae o'n golygu bod 'na un neu ddau wrthfiotig y byddwn ni'n eu hosgoi — a digon o rai eraill y medrwn ni eu defnyddio'n saff.
chunks: It means there are one or two antibiotics we'll avoid
Mae o'n golygu bod 'na un neu ddau wrthfiotig y byddwn ni'n eu hosgoi
⚠ line — the bod existential under a complement clause
and plenty of others we can use safely
a digon o rai eraill y medrwn ni eu defnyddio'n saff

turns.en: Good to know it's written down somewhere official.
turns.cy: Da gwybod ei fod o wedi'i sgwennu i lawr yn rhywle swyddogol.
chunks: Good to know it's written down somewhere official
Da gwybod ei fod o wedi'i sgwennu i lawr yn rhywle swyddogol
⚠ line — English's copula erases in the elliptical judgement; the wedi-passive under a bod clause

turns.en: Are you taking any medication at the moment?
turns.cy: Ydach chi'n cymryd unrhyw foddion ar y funud?
chunks: Are you taking any medication at the moment?
Ydach chi'n cymryd unrhyw foddion ar y funud?

turns.en: I'm on that many I can't remember them all. It's all on my repeat, whatever's on there.
turns.cy: Dw i ar gymaint fel na fedra i eu cofio nhw i gyd. Mae'r cwbl ar fy rhestr ailadrodd i, beth bynnag sy arni hi.
chunks: I'm on that many I can't remember them all
Dw i ar gymaint fel na fedra i eu cofio nhw i gyd
English's bare 'that many … I can't' relocates to the fel na result-clause, which Welsh needs and English can omit
It's all on my repeat, whatever's on there
Mae'r cwbl ar fy rhestr ailadrodd i, beth bynnag sy arni hi
English's clipped 'my repeat' becomes the full rhestr ailadrodd; the conjugated arni hi

turns.en: That's alright - do you have the repeat list with you?
turns.cy: Mae hynny'n iawn — oes gynnoch chi'r rhestr ailadrodd efo chi?
chunks: do you have the repeat list with you?
oes gynnoch chi'r rhestr ailadrodd efo chi?
possession relocates to the existential with conjugated gan

turns.en: Hold on, I've got it here in my bag somewhere...
turns.cy: Arhoswch funud — mae o gen i yn fan'ma yn fy mag i yn rhywle...
chunks: English's particle verb has no Welsh reflex; it converges with 'Hang on', which is reception
I've got it here in my bag somewhere...
mae o gen i yn fan'ma yn fy mag i yn rhywle...
south: mae e gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Arhoswch funud — mae e gyda fi fan hyn yn fy mag i yn rhywle...

turns.en: That list is gold - let me copy it in. Then I've got everything, and we can have a look at you.
turns.cy: Mae'r rhestr yna'n aur — gadwch i mi ei chopïo hi i mewn. Wedyn mae gen i bob dim, ac mi fedrwn ni gael golwg arnoch chi.
chunks: gadwch i mi ei chopïo hi i mewn
gadwch i mi (R3); feminine hi for rhestr
Wedyn mae gen i bob dim
sequential wedyn (S1); the gen i possessive
and we can have a look at you
ac mi fedrwn ni gael golwg arnoch chi
south: mae … gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Mae'r rhestr yna'n aur — gadewch i fi ei chopïo hi i mewn. Wedyn mae popeth gyda fi, ac fe allwn ni gael golwg arnoch chi.

turns.en: Right you are. Glad it's some use.
turns.cy: O'r gorau. Balch ei fod o o ryw ddefnydd.
chunks: Balch ei fod o o ryw ddefnydd
English's subject and copula both erase in the elliptical reply; the bod clause carries the rest
